Arabic shaper: joining, masks, fallback, mark reordering.

Ported from harfrust ot/shaper/arabic.rs + arabic_fallback.rs at a static-font scope. Syriac shares the joining machinery; Mongolian variation-selector propagation is included, as is the legacy Windows-1256 fixed-gid fallback. stch stretching and pre/post-context across buffer boundaries stay TODO.

../buffer, ../direction, ../feature, ../tag, ../unicode, apply, arabic_table, coverage, gsub

  ajU = 0,                  ## Non joining.
  ajL = 1,                  ## Left joining.
  ajR = 2,                  ## Right joining.
  ajD = 3,                  ## Dual joining.
  ajAlaph = 4,              ## Alaph joining.
  ajDalath = 5,             ## Dalath Rish joining.
  ajT = 6,                  ## Transparent joining.
  ajX = 7                    ## Unknown joining.
Arabic joining type. 
FallbackLig = tuple[first: uint16, rest: seq[uint16], lig: uint16]
Fallback ligature mapping. 
FallbackSingle = tuple[fromGid, toGid: uint16]
Fallback single substitution mapping.
